result.title: Physical-Field-Bridged Material Parameter Inference from Multi-View Deformation Videos
result.summary: Estimating simulation-ready material parameters from visual observations is crucial for deformable-object manipulation but challenging because material properties are only indirectly revealed through physical responses. We introduce physical-field-bridged material inference, a single-pass framework that uses dense physical responses to connect multi-view RGB deformation videos with constitutive-type classification and continuous parameter regression. Unlike inverse-physics methods requiring per-scene reconstruction, online tuning, or simulation-in-the-loop optimization, our model predicts force/contact masks, projected motion-flow fields, and projected stress-response maps, then conditions material inference on these fields to reduce reliance on appearance or category shortcuts. We construct DeformFieldBench, a 3DGS MPM learning environment comprising 5,000 simulations across 100 object shapes and five mechanically informative loading modes, with dense pixel-aligned physical supervision. Our method achieves the best median errors on all four continuous parameters, improves stress-hotspot recall from 0.0762 to 0.5121, and attains 0.8676 SSIM/36.82 dB PSNR in same-simulator replay on unseen objects. Under a protocol-matched GSO evaluation, inference and future-state prediction take approximately 30 seconds, compared with 15-120 minutes for per-scene optimization. The method also yields measurable replay agreement on five real-world sequences. These results support dense physical fields as an effective bridge for fast material inference, while cross-simulator and real-world tests reveal remaining domain and identifiability gaps.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「物理场桥接」的单次前向框架：从多视角形变视频预测力/接触掩码、运动流场与投影应力响应图，再据此推断材料本构类型与连续参数，并构建含 5000 次仿真的 DeformFieldBench 与稠密物理监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 以稠密中间物理场替代逐场景反演与仿真内循环优化的「单次推断」思路，可能与 LVR 关心的用预测中间状态替代测试时迭代计算、以及中间表示是否忠实（论文亦报告域偏移与可辨识性缺口）可供核查；但任务与 VLM 推理相距较远，联系尚属推测。
